purpose: Recover safely after ChatGPT message-delivery timeout or interrupted foreground tool chain without repeating durable research.

in_flight_unit.next_action: Create and verify the full 13F rebuild manifest, then advance CURRENT_STATE last to 13F and require the DELTA rebuild gate. After green CI, start only R037_DH03_S06_RECLAIM_LEVEL_CONSUMPTION_AND_PIVOT_REUSE_PARITY_RECONSTRUCTION.

timeout_recovery_algorithm: Compare delta branch HEAD with the durable current-state commit.
If HEAD contains only committed prereg/evidence for the first incomplete unit, resume from the next missing durability step; do not rerun completed steps.
Official compute is valid only from producer bytes committed before execution and exact blob-verified locally.
Persist result, report, workbook readback, full manifest, then advance CURRENT_STATE last.
Require DELTA rebuild artifact gate success before calling the unit durable.

execution_hardening.large_stdout_policy: Keep official producers summary-only; persist detailed diagnostics to JSON rather than streaming them through the chat/tool transport.
execution_hardening.chat_delivery_timeout_policy: Treat ChatGPT message-delivery timeout as transport/session interruption, never as proof of compute failure. On reconnect: read CURRENT_STATE, this pointer, recent branch commits and CI; if prereg/producer/result artifacts exist beyond the durable cursor, resume from the first missing durability step only.
execution_hardening.github_workflow_policy: Require rebuild gate success for every durable cursor; use workflow artifacts/recovery snapshots rather than uncommitted local state.
concurrent_old_chain_policy: Before every durable write, re-read CURRENT_STATE.json and branch HEAD/recent CI.

Prefer immutable create-only artifact paths for preregistration, producer, result and report. Treat an already-existing create/HTTP 422 as evidence that another chain may have progressed; stop and reconcile rather than overwrite.
If CURRENT_STATE or HEAD advances beyond the state used to prepare a write, abandon that write and resume from the newer authoritative cursor.
Only one reconciled checkpoint may advance CURRENT_STATE for a bounded scientific unit; parallel diagnostics remain supplementary/non-promoting unless explicitly incorporated by the durable manifest.
Never rerun an official compute solely because ChatGPT message delivery timed out. Verify committed result/report/workbook/manifest/CI first.

external_references.note: Python/GitHub controls harden compute and persistence but cannot directly eliminate a ChatGPT UI/message-delivery timeout. OpenAI troubleshooting treats conversation/network/browser/server errors separately from local compute; recent community reports show the same delivery error in long/project chats. Treat message delivery failure as transport unless durable artifacts/CI show scientific failure.
